title: SOWS Acquisition Screening
rules: S - Stale: Outdated website, no digital scheduling, paper invoices, zero SEO.
O - Old: Owner has run it for 15+ years and is mentally fatigued or retiring.
W - Weak: Has not raised prices in 3-5 years, leaking profit on un-optimized margins.
S - Simple: Essential service anyone can explain in 10 seconds. Recession-resistant.
